name: discord-codex-bridge

scripts.syntax: bash -n bin/discord-codex-bridge && bash -n scripts/install-systemd-user.sh && node --check src/index.js && node --check src/access-state.js && node --check src/config-paths.js && node --check scripts/manage-access.js && node --check scripts/send-message.js && node --check scripts/fetch-messages.js && node --check scripts/view-channel.js && node --check scripts/list-channels.js && node --check scripts/read-message.js
